decision.title: Template rules chosen from rule buckets by node kind and name (packet )

body.p: , after , , , , (its Proposed entry, now done and removed). No public header changed. Glossary: , , .

item.p: Whom it serves: every stylesheet with many template rules, first EN 16931's (the official XSLT and sxml's compiled Schematron). Pays: at compile time one pass over each pattern AST and a sort of each mode's names; per mode at most eight buckets of rule numbers plus one per element or attribute name its rules test (4 bytes per rule number); at run time one node description and two binary searches per item applied.

Profile (base 29719119c, release; a scratch-only hook in src/evaluator_template.c, not committed, counted the steps taken between a match function's call and its return): the invoice transform 1,359,249 evaluation steps, 1,201,091 of them (88 %) in 44,422 match calls for 1,324 items; validate --schematron 1,176,633, 1,031,291 (88 %) in 36,612 match calls for 1,111 items. An item tried 34 rules on average, nearly all of which could not match its kind or name.

Mechanism: sxml_xslt_pattern_find_requirement (src/xslt_pattern.c) reads what a pattern may match from its AST, as 's walked kinds did and now in one place: the last step of a path, both sides of a union, the left of intersect and except, the value of a filter, parentheses (XSLT 4.0, 6.3); an axis step gives its kind test's kind, or for a name test or wildcard the principal node kind of its axis (XPath 4.0, 4.6.4.1), and for an EQName of an element or attribute its expanded name, resolved as the lowerer resolves it; "##any" and typed modes (6.9.4, substitution groups) give elements of any name; "/" a document node; every other pattern ($v, id(), key(), doc(), simple patterns, .) any item. Every pattern may match items that are not XNodes (category OTHER: JNodes are not decided), so OTHER's bucket holds every rule. The lowering (src/xslt_lower_template.c) gives each mode its rule buckets (sxml_ir_rule_bucket, src/ir_internal.h): per category the rules that may match it whatever the name, and per name the rules that may match only some names of that category, the name among them; a typed mode's XTTE3100 rule is in every bucket. Buckets hold the unit's rule numbers, so each is in the mode's order (6.8: precedence, priority, the later declaration). APPLY_TEMPLATES (src/evaluator_template.c) describes the item, takes the bucket of its category and name and the bucket of its category, skips numbers below the first candidate (next-match) by binary search and merges the two in rule order; the precedence filter of apply-imports, on-multiple-match="fail" (ties among the candidates, which hold every rule that can match) and the built-in templates' apply-templates are unchanged, and streamed modes go through the same choice (: a streamed node is an XNode of its window; evaluator_stream's template rules applied node by node and XT40's streaming sets are unchanged). An item that is not an XNode or cannot be described takes OTHER's bucket: every rule, as before. The verifier checks the buckets (ordered by category and name, names only for elements and attributes, rules of the mode in increasing order). Not done: element() and attribute() tests with a name, processing-instruction(name) and JNode keys are indexed by kind only.

Measured (callgrind, release; base 29719119c and the change built alike from snapshots). Invoice transform 1.957 to 1.618 x 10^9 instructions, the transform itself 0.548 to 0.208 (the compile is unchanged, 1.409); steps 1,359,249 to 324,824, match calls 44,422 to 2,739. validate --schematron 1.903 to 1.613, validation 0.479 to 0.189; steps 1,176,633 to 287,135, match calls 36,612 to 2,526. The new benchmark tests/bench/xslt-many-rules.xsl (87 rules, one per XMark element name and for attributes and text, over every node of the XMark document, 152,795 items) 55.84 to 3.36 x 10^9; steps 165.2 M to 4.04 M, match calls 10,857,281 to 153,558. Processor seconds (a shared 4-CPU machine): invoice transform 0.262 to 0.222, validate 0.288 to 0.254 (fastest of 15, interleaved); run-bench.py --repeat 5: xslt-many-rules 6.972 to 0.463, xmark-all 1.075 to 1.093, xslt-key and xslt-match-variable within noise (interleaved reruns 0.465-0.507 against 0.459-0.475, 0.287-0.299 against 0.285-0.326); VEFA (sxml-schematron-test vefa, 1,131 tests) 4.36 to 3.10 s; the XT40 run 363.5 to 364.0 s (its stylesheets are small; compiles dominate).

Same result: the rule chosen is the one the whole mode in order would give (a skipped rule's match function returns false). Checked: the official EN 16931 XSLT's SVRL over the 1,131 UBL unit test documents (extracted from each VEFA <test>) and the 17 UBL examples, per document, identical; sxml validate --format=json with the .sch over the same 1,148 files in one run, 14.7 MB, byte-identical; xslt-many-rules and the other benchmarks' outputs equal. 7.30's suite through sxml-schematron-test run: 463 passed, 3 failed, 43 implementation-defined, 5 not applicable, as base; EN 16931 UBL 1,133 of 1,133 checks. New tests in tests/evaluator_template_test.c: rule_buckets (names and kinds interleaved by priority, a named rule below a kind-wide one, next-match from one bucket into the other, atomic items, on-multiple-match across buckets, the default element namespace) and rule_bucket_contents (the buckets a small stylesheet gets). Conformance setup: base and change built alike (preset , snapshots of 29719119c and of the change), run one after the other on the same machine with TZ, LANG and LC_ALL unset, from each snapshot's root: sxml-xslt-test run --format=json, sxml-qt4 run --spec=XP40 --format=json, sxml-qt4 run --spec=XQ40 --format=json (default catalogs; XP40 and XQ40 because src/ir.c and src/ir_internal.h changed). XT40 12,185, XP40 32,785, XQ40 46,114 passed in both: 0 outcomes differ, case by case (13,867, 47,313 and 47,313 cases). debug-gcc: the whole suite passed (459 tests; kotlin/jvm and swift/linux skipped) except evaluator_template, whose one wrong expectation (a union's default priority) was then corrected; at the commit the 329 tests matching evaluator_template, ir, xslt, schematron and cli pass. clang-tidy clean on the changed files; tools/check-call-cycles.py finds no cycle ().
